Le rendement baisse loin de la capitale: Output drops far from the capital and regional capitals; a conquered world takes a generation to reach full production; losing the capital throws the empire into disarray.
Politiques migratoires et minières : des: Migration and mining policies: automatic convoys, real and interceptable, move colonists and minerals.
Écran, ligne, artillerie ; ciblage par l: Screen, line, artillery; threat-based targeting (no more cheap decoys soaking up fire); retreat thresholds.
À certains niveaux, chaque empire choisi: At certain levels, each empire chooses between two mutually exclusive, permanent doctrines.
Constructions de longue haleine, qui app: Long-term constructions that appear as research draws near them; one of them wins the game, and the whole galaxy follows its progress.
Deux objectifs cachés par empire, révélé: Two hidden objectives per empire, revealed at the end; each one achieved earns score points.
Sans scanner pénétrant, la masse et le n: Without a penetrating scanner, the mass and number of detected fleets are estimates (±30%); holographic decoys inflate fleets.
Des anomalies à étudier avec un vaisseau: Anomalies to study with a ship carrying a scanner, archaeological sites to dig chapter by chapter, relics, the scattered map of the Ancients, and hidden stars to discover.
Des flottes immobiles et redoutables vei: Motionless, formidable fleets guard rich worlds far from the capitals. Defeating them yields research, minerals and sometimes a relic.
Chaque empire choisit une origine (monde: Each empire chooses an origin (doomed world, relic world, lost colony...) that changes its start.
Vers 2415, des bandes de pirates s'insta: Around 2415, pirate bands settle in lairs far from the capitals. Every few years, a raid plunders a rich, poorly defended colony. They can be paid to target a rival (an anonymous bounty); destroying a lair yields research and its loot.
Vers 2490-2520 selon la taille de la gal: Around 2490-2520, depending on the size of the galaxy, a Breach opens far from the empires (announced ten years in advance). Its guardian, the Nexus, is stronger than any fleet in the galaxy, and waves of Reapers pour out of it to ravage the worlds of the most powerful. At the Breach, empires do not fight one another; whoever brings down the Nexus wins the game.
Guerre, paix ou alliance entre chaque pa: War, peace or alliance between each pair of empires, trade and research agreements, tributes and gifts. Computer players hold an opinion of each empire, with its reasons, and respond to proposals according to rules shown in advance. You can only fight, invade and bomb empires you are at war with.
Ce que l'on sait des autres empires se c: What you know about other empires is built up over time: their worlds under your penetrating scanners or your ships in orbit, their identified ships, agreements and alliances, (reciprocal) embassies, spy networks, battles and conquests. The intelligence level (0 to 100) first reveals estimates, then the exact figures of their score, technology and fleet, and finally their research and secret objectives. Computer players judge your strength by what they know about you.
Qui tient le terrain après une bataille: Whoever holds the field after a battle studies the enemy wrecks: if they carried unknown components, its scientists progress toward them (a third of the next level in the field of the most advanced one), with better odds the more wrecks there are.
Les équipages qui survivent aux bataille: Crews that survive battles gain experience, above all by destroying enemy ships: five ranks, from Recruits to Legend, each with a little more damage and accuracy. Merging recruits into a seasoned fleet dilutes its experience. Every fleet keeps a log.
Un empire ordinateur se souvient des vai: A computer empire remembers the ships and worlds you took from it. Past a threshold, it swears your downfall: war as soon as it can, your weakest worlds as targets, no peace until it is broken (60% of the worlds it held, or its capital). Only one nemesis at a time.
La partie se joue en trois actes, chacun: The game is played in three acts, each announced by a title card: the Awakening (the computers make no war, no megaproject), the Rivalries (wars, megaprojects except the Portal, cataclysms), the Apotheosis (the Portal, research 15% cheaper, the Breach). The next act comes with time, or earlier when the galaxy changes (settlement, first war, race for the Portal).
Le Portail de l'Ascension demande trois: The Ascension Portal requires three Ascension relays, on three different worlds of the empire building it. The whole galaxy learns where they rise; losing a relay pauses the Portal's works.
Un empire qui perd son dernier monde sur: An empire that loses its last world survives as long as one of its arks carries colonists. The arks glean a little fuel every year; the first colony founded in exile becomes the new capital, with factories and mines brought in the holds.
À partir du deuxième acte (vers 2445 san: From the second act on (around 2445 without the acts), now and then, a supernova announced fifteen years ahead (everything is swept away within 35 ly, irradiated up to 70 ly) or a wandering black hole crossing the galaxy in a straight line. The ruins teem with heavy elements.
La culture que rayonnent vos mondes (pop: The culture your worlds radiate (population, capital, stations, cultural buildings, patronage) becomes inspiration; enough inspiration opens a ten-year golden age: 15% more resources and research. The next one asks for more. Requires the Culture and territories rule.
Tous les dix à quinze ans environ, un ch: Every ten to fifteen years or so, a hard choice: refugees, a vein, a renegade scientist, a strike, a cult, a wreck, mutations, a triumph. Two answers, their price stated, five years to decide (otherwise the second one applies). The computers face them too.
Tous les trente ou quarante ans, chaque: Every thirty or forty years, each empire lives a story in several stages, over one or two decades: a signal from a distant world, a plague to quarantine or not, a prophet to embrace or exile.
Ce qu'est la Brèche change à chaque part: What the Breach is changes with every game. Digs, anomalies, observing the Breach and the wrecks of the Reapers give clues; six reveal the truth and the way to seal it: the Seal of the Ancients, a megaproject whose site depends on the secret, which closes the Breach and wins the game. Requires the endgame crisis and the megaprojects.
Chaque siège (la capitale, une capitale: Each seat (the capital, a regional capital, or, without the "Cost of size" rule, a designated seat) forms a sector with the worlds it is closest to. A governor named at its head brings a talent that grows over the years (resources, cheaper factories and mines, cheaper defenses and stations, mining, culture) and can run the production queues of the sector by a standing order: development, industry, fortification or radiance. The governor raises the defenses when a hostile fleet approaches.
Chaque origine a sa propre victoire, que: Each origin has its own victory, which only its empire can reach, from 2430 on: stay in the lead for twenty-five years, build a new cradle, gather four relics, make the lost colony grow, map the galaxy, surpass the Ancients…
Chaque colonie rayonne autour d'elle, de: Each colony radiates around it, ever farther with its population, its age and its cultural buildings. You cannot colonize within another empire's territory, and a world dominated by a foreign culture ends up joining it after a few decades.
